summary.name: VSDECO
summary.one_liner: VSDECO is an AI tool that turns photos, SketchUp models, sketches and drawings of rooms into photorealistic interior renders in various design styles, including virtual staging and decluttering.
keywords: hand drawn sketch to realistic image
use_cases: Virtually staging empty property photos for listings
Turning SketchUp models into photorealistic renders
Visualizing room redesign ideas before renovating
summary.what_it_does: VSDECO takes an uploaded photo of a room, a SketchUp model, or a hand-drawn sketch and generates a photorealistic render. The user picks from a range of interior design styles to restyle the space. The page describes a decluttering function that removes excess furniture, countertop clutter or other distracting elements. Virtual staging is presented as a way to furnish property photos for listings. Generated images are stated to be available for commercial use.
notable: Accepts photos, SketchUp models and hand-drawn sketches as input
Built-in decluttering function for removing furniture and clutter
Subscription tiers at 35, 100 and 300 renders per month with no watermark
caveats: Refunds not offered due to GPU processing costs
Paid monthly subscriptions only; billing typically by credit card
